# Observability · alerting

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-blocks.mjs from scripts/blocks-meta.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

### Upstream probes
- What: Regular checks that the outside services the app depends on are working.
- Applies when: the app is live and depends on outside services.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Actionable alerts
- What: Send an alert only when someone needs to act, and say what to do.
- Applies when: the app is live and sends alerts.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: practice

### On-call and paging
- What: A rota of who responds when the app breaks out of hours.
- Applies when: a team keeps the app running.
- Stage: at-scale
- Kind: practice

### Runbooks
- What: Written steps for fixing problems that have happened before.
- Applies when: the app is live and things have gone wrong before.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: practice
